notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - Turkish localization!
notes.content:
Hey dieselminers!

Long time no see!

It's been a while since I announced the end of support for Ad Fundum, and I expected that there would be no further content updates or improvements, except for bug fixes. However, when I was approached by one of our Turkish players, Samet, with an offer to translate the game, I simply couldn't say no.

So, what's new in the patch 1.2.2?

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where Terrain depth monitor displayed incorrect altitude at which the player's mech would hit the ground (thanks to leforeg for the report);
 Ore at the bottom of level 3 can no longer become invisible when Claustrophobia safe mode on (thanks to leforeg for the report);
 Heat and cold auras are no longer producing a "ghosting" effect after new thruster upgrades are installed;
 Uninstalling certain special upgrades now removes their effects correctly;
 Fixed a bug where the game sometimes considered player to be out of the base upon loading. This bug was preventing saving and producing fuel drain issues at the base;
 Several text typos and misleading upgrade descriptions have been corrected;
 Laser defense system is now more effective at destroying chemotrophic plant seeds while the player is mining.


Balance changes:

 Laser defense system is now more effective at destroying chemotrophic plant seeds while the player is mining;
 LEVEL 8 SPOILER WARNING: [spoiler]The duration of "normal" gravity in the level 8 has been increased from 25 to 35 seconds.[/spoiler]


And, most importantly, the game now supports Turkish!
This has become possible thanks to the efforts of Samet Hüseyin Erdoğan and his friend Kerem Ün, who have voluntarily translated dozens of thousands of words of the game's text. Let's salute their valiant efforts!

Now, a word to Samet, who wants to reach out to the Turkish community:

Hello everyone!
Today I want to share a very exciting development with you. Recently, I discovered that Ad Fundum, a game I love to play in the browser, is also on Steam. I immediately thought that this great game should have Turkish language support and I took action. 
I reached out to dear Denis, the developer of the game, and offered to translate the game into Turkish. He responded positively to my offer and thanked me for this initiative. 
I do not claim that this translation is completely professional or error-free. I have been careful as much as I could, but I know that there may be minor errors. That's where I need your help! I would like you to share with me any translation errors or suggestions you notice while playing the game. Thanks to your feedback, we can further improve and update the Turkish language support.
I'd like to take this opportunity to make a call to the entire Turkish gaming community: Let's all take concrete steps to bring Turkish-language support to other games we love! I've contacted over 50 game developers so far, but unfortunately, most of them rejected me. Perhaps by combining our efforts, we can make an even stronger impact.
I hope you enjoy the Turkish translation of Ad Fundum and help us make it better with your feedback!

P.S. If you want to help bringing new languages to Ad Fundum or want to report issues with existing translations, please contact me at sergeev.denis.an@gmail.com

P.P.S. Stay tuned for the news about the console release of Ad Fundum ;)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.0a
Update 1.2.0 is finally here!
notes.content:
Hey dieselminers!
Great news! New Game+ is finally available in the main version of the game!

So, what does Update 1.2.0 include?

New Game+ features
New Game+ is aimed to make Ad Fundum endlessly replayable, so it includes:
[olist]
 Endless restarts.  After completing New Game+, you can start again in New Game++ and New Game +3 and so on. There is no limit to how many times you can restart, and the game adjusts tile hardness, ore prices and boss damage to keep up with your progress. Moreover, starting from New Game++, ore prices will randomly change providing a new challenge for you - to find ores that will yield maximum profits.

Of course, theoretically, at some point beyond NG+50, numbers in the game might break... but no one can reach that far, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/f45801c8b097628a9096e1da5c13f33fb2d9d2bd.png

 Infinite upgrades.  In New Game+, you will unlock infinite upgrades for your mech. The mining speed, fuel regeneration rate, anti-gravity effect duration, and 9 other parameters of your mech can all be upgraded indefinitely. These upgrades will allow you to become the ultimate mining god!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/e672b62e49316e2151c3b87645ebd05e44d2e6d4.gif

 New special upgrades. Also, in New Game+, you can discover new special upgrades with game-changing (or even game-breaking) effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/d9c132cdd3119e568b85e44fb0bd6ea3ff893883.gif

 New achievements. New Game+ comes with several new achievements, some of which require skill to unlock. Sorry, folks with 100% achievements, but you can't rest on your laurels!
[/olist]
Improvements since Open Beta
Compared to 1.2.0.beta.6, Update 1.2.0 includes the following improvements:

 Fixed a bug with the Cargo Cleanse protocol working inconsistently (thanks to Wylab and Sandbag for their help in tracking down the issue);
 Ore minimap colors when using the Ore Detector have been adjusted  to make them more distinguishable;
 An issue where returning to the save slots menu after New Game+ settings menu would make the save slots not interactable has been fixed;
 A problem with aggressive plants at level 5 randomly turning off when the player leaves their attack range has been resolved (thanks to Pico for the report).

Open Beta version of the game will be discontinued today, as it is no longer required. Steam should automatically change the version of your game to the main branch.

What's next?
Unfortunately, this is the last content update for Ad Fundum. There are still things in the game that I want to improve and bugs to fix, so there will be 1 or 2 more updates aimed at increasing the game's performance and adding some small QoL features, but that would be it.

After that, however, I will focus on bringing Ad Fundum to other platforms. Right now, I cannot say exactly which platforms Ad Fundum will visit, as this depends on a publisher that I have not found yet. However, I can assure you that I will aim for as many platforms as I can.

What's coming with the update 1.2.0: new upgrades, new game modes and more
notes.content:
Hey dieselminers!

It's been a while since the last update for Ad Fundum was released and I'm still working on the New Game+ update. So, I wanted to share some details about update 1.2.0 with you.

What will this update include?

New Game+
What could be better than starting a new game, saving all your upgrades, items, and most importantly, the profits? Starting over again! In 1.2.0 update, you will be able to start New Game+, then – New Game++, New Game+++ and so on. The game will adapt to your mech with each new playthrough. Yes, just like in Dark Souls!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/f45801c8b097628a9096e1da5c13f33fb2d9d2bd.png

Infinite upgrades
Of course, it wouldn't make sense to have endless restarts without anything to spend your hard-earned money on. After starting a New Game+, you'll unlock infinite upgrades for your mech. Progress has no limits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/e672b62e49316e2151c3b87645ebd05e44d2e6d4.gif

New special upgrades
And what is the point of starting a new game if there is nothing new to discover? That's why in New Game+, you will be able to find 8 new special upgrades. Some of them have insane effects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/d9c132cdd3119e568b85e44fb0bd6ea3ff893883.gif

Finally, there are small improvements, such as:
[olist]
 Ability to use extra fuel tanks shortly after running out of fuel;
 New sounds for the treasure detector and for taking damage when your health is low;
 New visual effects to indicate when the mech is overheating or overcooling;
 One-life mode for those looking for an even more challenging experience;
 Option to turn off all story dialogue for those who know the story of the game already.
[/olist]
And many other minor improvements and fixes to make the game better!

When will the update be released? 

Everything is ready, but there's still a lot of balancing and testing to do. It should take me 7-14 days to finish everything, but as you may know from my previous messages, I'm quite bad at predicting release dates :) 
So I can only say the update will be released soon, but time is relative.


P.S. I would also like to apologize for the delay in releasing the update. Some issues in my life have distracted me from working on the game and, since I am a solo developer, progress has been halted for over a month. However, I am devoting as much time as possible to improving the game.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Steam Input support!
Open beta update - Ad Fundum is now available on Steam Deck in beta!
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

Ad Fundum is finally playable on Steam Deck! 

It is currently in beta, so you may encounter some minor issues. However, based on the test results, it seems to be working fine. 

To play Ad Fundum on your Steam Deck, you need to join the open beta. To do so, select "Ad Fundum" from your library, then go to "Properties" > "Betas" > "Beta participation", and choose "Open Beta - Open beta for Steam Input Testing". 

Once I'm sure there are no issues with Steam Input, the game will be available to everyone. And if you join the beta, please let me know about any problems you encounter.

If you experience any bugs related to the unending earthquakes or other bugs that appear to be an issue even after reloading the game, please send your save file to one of these:

1. My email: tech-support@oldbut-gold.space (this is not actually some kind of a tech support email, it goes directly to me);
2. My Discord server: https://discord.gg/v3AaBWmyhq (create a new post in the bugs forum with your save file);
3. Or, to my DM on Discord. To do this, you will need to join my Discord server and send me a friend request (I usually accept such requests within a matter of minutes, if I'm not sleeping).

Most of such bugs occur due to a combination of factors that are extremely difficult to replicate, even with a detailed description of the issue. Save files could greatly assist me in tracking down and fixing them.

The save files are located in:

Windows: C:\Users\{UserName}\AppData\LocalLow\Oldbut Gold\Ad Fundum\Saves (the AppData folder is hidden, you may need to make it visible)

Linux: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Ad Fundum or $HOME/.config/unity3d/Ad Fundum

Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Oldbut Gold/Ad Fundum

notes.title: Ad Fundum is finally released!
notes.content:
The time has come, my friends! 

After years of hard work, passion and unhealthy perfectionism, Ad Fundum has finally been released! And the release is not the end of Ad Fundum's journey - it's a new chapter in its story!


So what's next?

1. Steam Input support
My primary goals for the first week are to add Steam Input support so that Steam Deck owners can play the game to its full potential, and of course, to fix any bugs and address any issues that will inevitably arise during the first week after the release) 

2. QoL improvements
Once Steam Input is added and bug fixing is done, I'll focus on some quality-of-life improvements that I couldn't implement before the release, such as buying 5 items at once in the shop, adding better structure to the Special Upgrades UI  and so on.

3. New Game+ 
After QoL, I will focus on the New Game+, which will not just be an option to restart the game with current upgrades. I am planning to introduce some overpowered special upgrades that could drastically change the standard gameplay. It may take several weeks for New Game+ to be available in Ad Fundum, but it will be well worth the wait!

4. Game's soundtrack 
Additionally, great news for those who enjoyed the music in Ad Fundum: the soundtrack will be released in 1-2 weeks!


Feel free to share your thoughts and ideas!

And most importantly, I'm always open to suggestions. If you have any thoughts on how to make Ad Fundum better, please let me know! I will listen to everyone and do my best to provide the best possible gaming experience for you, the players!

P.S. The easiest and fastest way to reach me is to join my Discord server, it usually takes a couple of hours or even minutes for me to notice and respond to your question there.

This is a small update, but it brings a couple of cool new features:

1. Added a new item - Reinforcement Beams. Use them to protect your mines from destruction and stones from falling on your mech during an earthquake. However, they will not save you from the earthquake itself! (thanks to the user Marker for the suggestion)

2. You can now buy or use items multiple times by holding down the relevant button.

notes.title: Update 1.2 Demo & Mac OS support
notes.content:
Great news for Mac users - Mac OS support will be available upon release, and now you can already play the demo on your machines!

Update 1.2 also brings important changes and fixes:

1. Added short version of tutorial - now you can play the beginning of the game without those irritating messages from Prometheus!

2. Reworked New games settings menu - there is beauty in the simplicity... until you want to customize the difficulty!

3. Stonefall during earthquakes has been reworked - now the number of stones falling is more justified, but on average, it's higher than before.

4.  Consumable items have been reworked - the maximum amount of extra fuel tanks and repair kits in the inventory has been limited. To expand the limits, you'll need to upgrade the maintenance station. Otherwise, with 100 Extra fuel tanks in the bank the game is too simple, right?

P.S. You can turn those limits off in the New game settings.


Balance changes:

1. The prices of Extra fuel tanks and Repair kit have been doubled, but their effects have also been doubled. This was done mainly to avoid having to press the item button a hundred of times to refuel or repair your mech in the middle and late game. Now, you will only need to press it 50 times. :)

2. The costs of Maintenance station upgrades have been increased to reflect their new effects.


Bug fixes:

1. Fixed a bug where the mech would get stuck in the air after dying due to running out of fuel;

2. Fixed an issue with radio wave selector not working properly;

3. Fixed a bug that caused vault completion trigger to be activated too early;

4. Fixed a bug where the player entered the shop long after pressing the corresponding button.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1a Demo
Update 1.1.1 Demo
Update 1.1 Demo has finally arrived - Custom difficulty and more!
notes.content:
Custom difficulty
The most significant change that it includes is Custom difficulty. Now, when starting a new game, you can configure various aspects of the game to create the best suited experience for you!

Don't like the fact that your mines are destroyed after each earthquake? No problem! You can now disable map regeneration. Want to relax without worrying about fuel and damage? Change the settings, and no more dying from running out of fuel or crashing onto the surface!

If you would like more options for custom difficulty, let me know in the Discussion section or on my Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/006479f3add6def1e5b493b8917e084678557d77.gif


Cancel mining
Another addition is the ability to cancel mining process. No longer will you need to watch as your mech digs gold only to throw it away because the cargo storage is full! You can hold the movement button in the opposite direction to the mining, and if you do this before you mined 50% of a tile, your mech will stop mining and return to the starting point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716684/56b160c4a6060df855bb957847946b7c581205fd.gif


Special upgrades rebalance
The last change is about special upgrades. From now on, finding a special upgrade won't give you money, but it will only unlock that upgrade in the Mech workshop building. However, if you find the second instance of the same upgrade, you'll get 50% off the price of that upgrade. 


Bug fixes
The update also contains a number of bug fixes:
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with fuel consuming too slowly when difficulty option "Fuel drain" is on (thanks to the user SandBag for noticing);
 Treasure names in the Collections menu are now displayed correctly;
 Fixed an issue with the description of Thermal stabilizer not appearing in English (thanks to the user Lancerichy for noticing);
 Fixed an issue with some texts not appearing in the Inventory menu in Spanish and Japanese (thanks to the user MPV070 for noticing);
 Resource piles found during an earthquake will now not be collected if the option "Mine ore when the storage tank is full" is off and, well, the storage tank is full.
[/olist]

P.S. Actually, the update was released yesterday. However, I was so tired from working on it that I fell asleep before finishing this post. Sorry for keeping you waiting)
